title: 공정하게 모델을 비교하고 개선하기
description: 훈련 점수만 높은 과적합을 알아봐요. 설정은 검증과 교차검증으로 고르고, 테스트 자료는 마지막에 한 번만 써요. 필수 문제 8개와 선택 도전 2개예요.

tasks.title: 훈련 점수만 높으면 과적합이에요
tasks.goal:
자료엔 우연히 틀린 기록, 곧 잡음(noise)이 섞여요. 잡음까지 외운 모델은 답만 외운 학생 같아요.
훈련 점수는 높은데 처음 보는 자료에선 떨어져요. 이걸 과적합(overfitting)이라고 해요.
`max_depth`는 결정트리가 몇 단계까지 갈라질지 정해요. None이면 끝까지 갈라져요.

자, 먼저 실행해서 훈련 정확도와 테스트 정확도의 차이를 보세요.
`max_depth=None`을 `max_depth=3`으로 바꾸세요.
다시 실행해서 두 점수와 차이가 어떻게 달라졌는지 비교해요.

import pandas as pd
# 이 문제에 쓰는 도구를 불러와요.
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score

# 직접 만든 빵 공장 기록이에요. 실제 공장 자료가 아니에요.
df = pd.read_csv('data/bakery.csv')
# weight는 반죽 무게, humidity는 습도, temp는 오븐 온도예요.
# minutes는 굽는 시간이에요. defect가 1이면 불량 빵이에요.
X = df.drop(columns=['defect'])
y = df['defect']
# 테스트 몫 25%는 마지막 확인용으로 남겨 둬요.
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(
    X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42, stratify=y)

# max_depth로 나무의 깊이를 정해요. None은 제한 없음이에요.
model = DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=None, random_state=42)
# 학습은 훈련 자료로만 해요.
model.fit(X_train, y_train)
# 같은 모델을 훈련 자료와 테스트 자료로 각각 채점해요.
train_acc = accuracy_score(y_train, model.predict(X_train))
test_acc = accuracy_score(y_test, model.predict(X_test))
print('훈련 정확도:', round(train_acc, 3))
print('테스트 정확도:', round(test_acc, 3))
# 차이가 크면 과적합을 의심해요.
print('차이:', round(train_acc - test_acc, 3))

class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    # Replace only the first prepared assignment to each changed name.
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = values
        self.seen = set()

    def visit_Assign(self, node):
        if len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name):
            name = node.targets[0].id
            if name in self.values and name not in self.seen:
                self.seen.add(name)
                node.value = ast.parse(repr(self.values[name]), mode='eval').body
        return node


def execute(text, values):
    tree = ast.fix_missing_locations(Inputs(values).visit(ast.parse(text)))
    scope = {'__name__': '__main__'}
    output = io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(output):
        exec(compile(tree, 'main.py', 'exec'), scope)
    plt = sys.modules.get('matplotlib.pyplot')
    if plt is not None:
        plt.close('all')
    return output.getvalue().rstrip('

def same(actual, expected):
    pd = sys.modules.get('pandas')
    if pd is not None and isinstance(expected, (pd.DataFrame, pd.Series, pd.Index)):
        if type(actual) is not type(expected):
            return False
        try:
            if isinstance(expected, pd.DataFrame):
                pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(actual, expected)
            elif isinstance(expected, pd.Series):
                pd.testing.assert_series_equal(actual, expected)
            else:
                pd.testing.assert_index_equal(actual, expected)
            return True
        except AssertionError:
            return False
    np = sys.modules.get('numpy')
    if np is not None and isinstance(expected, np.ndarray):
        # Model and scaler outputs: same shape, and values equal up to float rounding.
        if not isinstance(actual, np.ndarray) or actual.shape != expected.shape:
            return False
        if expected.dtype.kind in 'fc':
            return bool(np.allclose(actual, expected, rtol=1e-7, atol=1e-9, equal_nan=True))
        return bool(np.array_equal(actual, expected))
    if isinstance(expected, float) and isinstance(actual, (int, float)):
        return math.isclose(actual, expected, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-12)
    try:
        return bool(actual == expected)
    except Exception:

class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    # Replace only the first prepared assignment to each changed name.
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = values
        self.seen = set()

    def visit_Assign(self, node):
        if len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name):
            name = node.targets[0].id
            if name in self.values and name not in self.seen:
                self.seen.add(name)
                node.value = ast.parse(repr(self.values[name]), mode='eval').body
        return node


def execute(text, values):

    scope = {'__name__': '__main__'}

def same(actual, expected):
    pd = sys.modules.get('pandas')

        try:

            elif isinstance(expected, pd.Series):

            else:

    np = sys.modules.get('numpy')

class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    # Replace only the first prepared assignment to each changed name.
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = values
        self.seen = set()

    def visit_Assign(self, node):
        if len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name):
            name = node.targets[0].id
            if name in self.values and name not in self.seen:
                self.seen.add(name)
                node.value = ast.parse(repr(self.values[name]), mode='eval').body
        return node


def execute(text, values):
    tree = ast.fix_missing_locations(Inputs(values).visit(ast.parse(text)))
    scope = {'__name__': '__main__'}
    output = io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(output):
        exec(compile(tree, 'main.py', 'exec'), scope)
    plt = sys.modules.get('matplotlib.pyplot')
    if plt is not None:
        plt.close('all')
    return output.getvalue().rstrip('
'), scope


def same(actual, expected):
    pd = sys.modules.get('pandas')
    if pd is not None and isinstance(expected, (pd.DataFrame, pd.Series, pd.Index)):
        if type(actual) is not type(expected):
            return False
        try:
            if isinstance(expected, pd.DataFrame):
                pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(actual, expected)
            elif isinstance(expected, pd.Series):
                pd.testing.assert_series_equal(actual, expected)
            else:
                pd.testing.assert_index_equal(actual, expected)
            return True
        except AssertionError:
            return False
    np = sys.modules.get('numpy')
    if np is not None and isinstance(expected, np.ndarray):
        # Model and scaler outputs: same shape, and values equal up to float rounding.
        if not isinstance(actual, np.ndarray) or actual.shape != expected.shape:
            return False
        if expected.dtype.kind in 'fc':
            return bool(np.allclose(actual, expected, rtol=1e-7, atol=1e-9, equal_nan=True))
        return bool(np.array_equal(actual, expected))
    if isinstance(expected, float) and isinstance(actual, (int, float)):
        return math.isclose(actual, expected, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-12)
    try:
        return bool(actual == expected)

def snapshot(inputs):

    produced = {}
    for path in Path('.').rglob('*'):

def run_in_fresh_folder(files, text, values):
    # Each run gets its own copy of the data, so files one run writes never help another.
    home = os.getcwd()
    folder = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=home)

        for path, content in files.items():
            target = Path(path)

            target.write_text(content, encoding='utf8')

class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    # Replace only the first prepared assignment to each changed name.
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = values
        self.seen = set()

    def visit_Assign(self, node):
        if len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name):
            name = node.targets[0].id
            if name in self.values and name not in self.seen:
                self.seen.add(name)
                node.value = ast.parse(repr(self.values[name]), mode='eval').body
        return node


def execute(text, values):

    pd = sys.modules.get('pandas')

        try:

            elif isinstance(expected, pd.Series):

            else:
                pd.testing.assert_index_equal(actual, expected)

    np = sys.modules.get('numpy')

        if not isinstance(actual, np.ndarray) or actual.shape != expected.shape:

def snapshot(inputs):

    produced = {}

def run_in_fresh_folder(files, text, values):
    # Each run gets its own copy of the data, so files one run writes never help another.
    home = os.getcwd()
    folder = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=home)
    try:

            target = Path(path)
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_text(content, encoding='utf8')
            inputs[target.as_posix()] = target.read_bytes()

    finally:

class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    # Replace only the first prepared assignment to each changed name.
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = values
        self.seen = set()

    def visit_Assign(self, node):
        if len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name):
            name = node.targets[0].id
            if name in self.values and name not in self.seen:
                self.seen.add(name)
                node.value = ast.parse(repr(self.values[name]), mode='eval').body
        return node

`best_score_`는 교차검증 평균이에요. 훈련 자료 안에서 낸 검증 점수죠.
`best_estimator_`는 고른 설정으로 훈련 자료 전체에 다시 학습한 모델이에요.
마지막 성적은 이 모델로 테스트 자료를 한 번 채점해서 내요.

먼저 실행해서 교차검증 점수와 테스트 정확도가 같은지 보세요.
test_acc 줄을 아래처럼 바꾸세요.
`test_acc = accuracy_score(y_test, grid.best_estimator_.predict(X_test))`
다시 실행해서 두 점수를 견줘 보세요. 달라도 괜찮아요. 보고할 성적은 테스트 정확도예요.

from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, GridSearchCV
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score

# 직접 만든 빵 공장 기록이에요. 실제 공장 자료가 아니에요.
df = pd.read_csv('data/bakery.csv')
# weight는 반죽 무게, humidity는 습도, temp는 오븐 온도예요.
# minutes는 굽는 시간이에요. defect가 1이면 불량 빵이에요.
X = df.drop(columns=['defect'])
y = df['defect']
# 테스트 몫 25%는 마지막 확인용으로 남겨 둬요.
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(
    X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42, stratify=y)

# 앞 문제에서 넓힌 후보예요.
param_grid = {'max_depth': [2, 3, 4, 6], 'min_samples_leaf': [1, 5]}
grid = GridSearchCV(DecisionTreeClassifier(random_state=42), param_grid, cv=3)
# 찾기는 훈련 자료로만 해요.
grid.fit(X_train, y_train)
print('고른 설정:', grid.best_params_)
print('교차검증 점수:', round(grid.best_score_, 3))
# 고른 모델의 마지막 성적이에요. 테스트 자료로 한 번만 채점해요.
test_acc = grid.best_score_
print('테스트 정확도:', round(test_acc, 3))

class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    # Replace only the first prepared assignment to each changed name.
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = values
        self.seen = set()

    def visit_Assign(self, node):
        if len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name):
            name = node.targets[0].id
            if name in self.values and name not in self.seen:
                self.seen.add(name)
                node.value = ast.parse(repr(self.values[name]), mode='eval').body
        return node


def execute(text, values):
    tree = ast.fix_missing_locations(Inputs(values).visit(ast.parse(text)))
    scope = {'__name__': '__main__'}
    output = io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(output):
        exec(compile(tree, 'main.py', 'exec'), scope)
    plt = sys.modules.get('matplotlib.pyplot')
    if plt is not None:
        plt.close('all')
    return output.getvalue().rstrip('
'), scope


def same(actual, expected):
    pd = sys.modules.get('pandas')
    if pd is not None and isinstance(expected, (pd.DataFrame, pd.Series, pd.Index)):
        if type(actual) is not type(expected):
            return False
        try:
            if isinstance(expected, pd.DataFrame):
                pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(actual, expected)
            elif isinstance(expected, pd.Series):
                pd.testing.assert_series_equal(actual, expected)
            else:
                pd.testing.assert_index_equal(actual, expected)
            return True
        except AssertionError:
            return False
    np = sys.modules.get('numpy')
    if np is not None and isinstance(expected, np.ndarray):
        # Model and scaler outputs: same shape, and values equal up to float rounding.
        if not isinstance(actual, np.ndarray) or actual.shape != expected.shape:
            return False
        if expected.dtype.kind in 'fc':
            return bool(np.allclose(actual, expected, rtol=1e-7, atol=1e-9, equal_nan=True))
        return bool(np.array_equal(actual, expected))
    if isinstance(expected, float) and isinstance(actual, (int, float)):
        return math.isclose(actual, expected, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-12)
    try:
        return bool(actual == expected)
    except Exception:
        return False


def fail(message):
    # The learner reads only this message, never the checker's own traceback.
    print(message, file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)


def snapshot(inputs):
    # Files the run created or changed, such as a saved result CSV.
    produced = {}
    for path in Path('.').rglob('*'):
        if path.is_file() and inputs.get(path.as_posix()) != path.read_bytes():
            produced[path.as_posix()] = path.read_bytes()
    return produced

    # Each run gets its own copy of the data, so files one run writes never help another.
    home = os.getcwd()
    folder = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=home)

            target = Path(path)
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_text(content, encoding='utf8')
            inputs[target.as_posix()] = target.read_bytes()
        output, scope = execute(text, values)
        return output, scope, snapshot(inputs)
    finally:
        os.chdir(home)
        shutil.rmtree(folder, ignore_errors=True)

class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    # Replace only the first prepared assignment to each changed name.
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = values

    def visit_Assign(self, node):
        if len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name):

                node.value = ast.parse(repr(self.values[name]), mode='eval').body
        return node

def figures():
    plt = sys.modules.get('matplotlib.pyplot')

    shapes = []
    for number in plt.get_fignums():

        for ax in figure.axes:

            lines = [numbers(line.get_xdata()) + ['|'] + numbers(line.get_ydata()) for line in ax.get_lines()]
            points = []
            for collection in ax.collections:
                offsets = np.asarray(collection.get_offsets())
                if offsets.size:
                    points.append(sorted(tuple(round(float(v), 4) for v in row) for row in offsets.reshape(-1, 2)))
                values = collection.get_array() if hasattr(collection, 'get_array') else None
                if values is not None and getattr(values, 'size', 0):

            # texts: numbers written on cells, such as a heatmap drawn with annot=True.

class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    # Replace only the first prepared assignment to each changed name.
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = values
        self.seen = set()

    def visit_Assign(self, node):
        if len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name):
            name = node.targets[0].id
            if name in self.values and name not in self.seen:
                self.seen.add(name)
                node.value = ast.parse(repr(self.values[name]), mode='eval').body
        return node

class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    # Replace only the first prepared assignment to each changed name.
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = values
        self.seen = set()

    def visit_Assign(self, node):
        if len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name):
            name = node.targets[0].id
            if name in self.values and name not in self.seen:
                self.seen.add(name)
                node.value = ast.parse(repr(self.values[name]), mode='eval').body
        return node


def execute(text, values):

    scope = {'__name__': '__main__'}

    return output.getvalue().rstrip('

def same(actual, expected):
    pd = sys.modules.get('pandas')

        try:

            elif isinstance(expected, pd.Series):

            else:

    np = sys.modules.get('numpy')

def snapshot(inputs):

    produced = {}

        if path.is_file() and inputs.get(path.as_posix()) != path.read_bytes():

def run_in_fresh_folder(files, text, values):
    # Each run gets its own copy of the data, so files one run writes never help another.
    home = os.getcwd()
    folder = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=home)
    try:
        os.chdir(folder)
        inputs = {}
        for path, content in files.items():
            target = Path(path)
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_text(content, encoding='utf8')
            inputs[target.as_posix()] = target.read_bytes()
        output, scope = execute(text, values)
        return output, scope, snapshot(inputs)
    finally:

class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    # Replace only the first prepared assignment to each changed name.
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = values
        self.seen = set()

    def visit_Assign(self, node):
        if len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name):
            name = node.targets[0].id
            if name in self.values and name not in self.seen:
                self.seen.add(name)
                node.value = ast.parse(repr(self.values[name]), mode='eval').body
        return node


def execute(text, values):

def same(actual, expected):
    pd = sys.modules.get('pandas')
    if pd is not None and isinstance(expected, (pd.DataFrame, pd.Series, pd.Index)):
        if type(actual) is not type(expected):
            return False
        try:
            if isinstance(expected, pd.DataFrame):
                pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(actual, expected)
            elif isinstance(expected, pd.Series):
                pd.testing.assert_series_equal(actual, expected)
            else:
                pd.testing.assert_index_equal(actual, expected)
            return True
        except AssertionError:
            return False
    np = sys.modules.get('numpy')
    if np is not None and isinstance(expected, np.ndarray):
        # Model and scaler outputs: same shape, and values equal up to float rounding.
        if not isinstance(actual, np.ndarray) or actual.shape != expected.shape:
            return False
        if expected.dtype.kind in 'fc':
            return bool(np.allclose(actual, expected, rtol=1e-7, atol=1e-9, equal_nan=True))
        return bool(np.array_equal(actual, expected))
    if isinstance(expected, float) and isinstance(actual, (int, float)):
        return math.isclose(actual, expected, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-12)
    try:
        return bool(actual == expected)
    except Exception:
        return False


def fail(message):
    # The learner reads only this message, never the checker's own traceback.
    print(message, file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)


def snapshot(inputs):
    # Files the run created or changed, such as a saved result CSV.
    produced = {}
    for path in Path('.').rglob('*'):
        if path.is_file() and inputs.get(path.as_posix()) != path.read_bytes():
            produced[path.as_posix()] = path.read_bytes()
    return produced


def run_in_fresh_folder(files, text, values):
    # Each run gets its own copy of the data, so files one run writes never help another.
    home = os.getcwd()
    folder = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=home)
    try:
        os.chdir(folder)
        inputs = {}
        for path, content in files.items():
            target = Path(path)
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_text(content, encoding='utf8')
            inputs[target.as_posix()] = target.read_bytes()
        output, scope = execute(text, values)
        return output, scope, snapshot(inputs)
    finally:
        os.chdir(home)
        shutil.rmtree(folder, ignore_errors=True)

    return ', '.join(parts)
